commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will take a throw-in.
90+6' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+5' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Benicio Baker-Boaitey (Brighton), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
90+3' That's a clear yellow card. Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book.
90+3' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Lewis Hall can be given a rest.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' PENALTY APPEAL after Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
88' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
87' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Odeluga Offiah (Brighton) replaces Simon Adingra.
87' Substitution. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) in, Billy Gilmour out.
87' The goal by Newcastle is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
86' The Newcastle players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
85' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) latched on to a sweet ball in the box and coolly slotted in near the left post.
83' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jakub Moder (Brighton).
83' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
82' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) misses a sitter as his shot goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
81' The attendance for today's match is 51997.
79' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
79' The resulting corner, taken by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), comes to nothing.
78' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. Now Newcastle have a corner.
77' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
76' Darren England blows his whistle and it's Lewis Dunk (Brighton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
76' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
75' Benicio Baker-Boaitey (Brighton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:12.
73' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
70' The referee blows his whistle as Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was too aggressive in his challenge.
68' The substitution has been made. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) has replaced Alexander Isak.
68' The substitution is prepared. Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jacob Murphy.
68' Substitution. Sean Longstaff did his best and is replaced by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd).
67' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Facundo Buonanotte is replaced by Benicio Baker-Boaitey (Brighton).
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Julio Enciso as he is replaced by Jakub Moder (Brighton).
66' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' A cross from Danny Welbeck (Brighton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
64' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Julio Enciso (Brighton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
63' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
62' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
62' One of the players from Brighton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
61' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Bart Verbruggen punches the ball away.
60' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.

60' Julio Enciso (Brighton) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
59' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
59' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
58' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
57' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
56' A lofted cross from Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
55' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
54' The expression of the referee Darren England is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Julio Enciso (Brighton) is shown a yellow card.
53' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
52' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
50' The Brighton players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Julio Enciso (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
47' Pascal Gross (Brighton) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Darren England has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Elliot Anderson sets up Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
45+4' The referee gives a yellow card to Billy Gilmour (Brighton).
45+4' He should have scored! Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
45+3' Newcastle are ruled offside.

45+2' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
44' The corner kick from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

44' Julio Enciso (Brighton) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
44' Julio Enciso (Brighton) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
43' Julio Enciso (Brighton) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a low shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Martin Dubravka hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.

42' Simon Adingra swings in a perfect cross for Julio Enciso (Brighton), who unfortunately sends a poor header high over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
42' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) meets a cross inside the box, but Bart Verbruggen wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
40' Roberto De Zerbi is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Joel Veltman (Brighton) suffers an injury and Tariq Lamptey comes on.
39' Joel Veltman (Brighton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
38' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross in and finds Alexander Isak inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
37' Julio Enciso (Brighton) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Danny Welbeck, but Martin Dubravka displays great awareness to stop him.
35' The resulting corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
35' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
34' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

34' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
33' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) heads on.
29' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes a short corner kick.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' Pascal Gross (Brighton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren England blows for a foul.

28' Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
28' A pass from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Bart Verbruggen and the move breaks down.
26' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

24' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Bart Verbruggen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
22' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
20' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! Joel Veltman (Brighton) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
18' Pascal Gross (Brighton) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
17' Joel Veltman (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Brighton manage to earn a corner.
15' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) commits a foul and Darren England immediately signals a free kick.
15' Martin Dubravka leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pascal Gross (Brighton).
14' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.

12' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a throw-in.
10' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

10' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle. Brighton are awarded a free kick.

8' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
8' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
8' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
7' The foul by Simon Adingra (Brighton) was seen by Darren England who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' Julio Enciso (Brighton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

6' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
5' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) and blew his whistle. Newcastle have a free kick.
3' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
2' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Newcastle win a corner kick.
2' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Darren England was nominated as the referee for this game.
